description: Source code for MD5 cryptographic hash implementation for Linux kernel, specifically for Infineon Technologies' Data Encryption Unit (DEU) hardware driver.

methods.name: endian_swap
methods.description: Performs a 32-bit endian swap on input.

methods.name: md5_transform
methods.description: Main interface to MD5 hardware, processes a 64-byte block.

methods.name: md5_transform_helper
methods.description: Helper function to call md5_transform with current context.

methods.name: md5_update
methods.description: Processes input data on-the-fly for MD5 hashing.

methods.name: md5_final
methods.description: Computes the final MD5 hash value.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_md5
methods.description: Registers MD5 driver with Linux crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_md5
methods.description: Unregisters MD5 driver from Linux crypto API.
